author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Anbernic's latest handheld is a slight modification of an existing device, but better suited for a more genuine GBA experience, thanks to its 3x integer scale screen and other modern conveniences.

The RG SP isn't up for sale yet, I'll add links when it's available.

Genki Moonbase: https://amzn.to/4xcDGX2
NextUI (H700 version): https://github.com/pvaibhav/NextUI/releases

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
